paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra, at the beginning of chapter 8, he had a case. The judges were Rav Huna, Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi and R’ Achai.

notes.text: The judge abbreviated ר״ה is not securely identified in this notice.

The saved whole Guggenheimer Bava Batra 8:1 paragraph explicitly names Rav Huna, Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi and Rav Acha as judges in Yannai the Cappadocian’s case. It supports Huna for ר״ה. Hyman’s third judge is אחאי with abbreviated ר׳, retained here as R’ Achai; the older Rabbi expansion is not newly confirmed by the witness’s Rav Acha. No broader identity or title harmonization is admitted.

The case is in Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:1. The consulted text explicitly names Rav Huna, resolving the abbreviation ר״ה discussed in the earlier note. It calls the third judge Rav Acha, while Hyman’s printed notice (vol. II, p. 769) has R’ Achai (ר׳ אחאי).
